# MenuGroup

MenuGroup: the scrollable list a menu's sections sit in.

**Import:** `import { MenuGroup } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/MenuGroup/MenuGroup.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/MenuGroup/MenuGroup.stories.jsx` — ButtonAndLinkItems, KeyboardNavigation, Selected, CustomRowExample, Density, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused, SelectedRow, Disabled

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/navigation/MenuGroup/MenuGroup.mdx`

## Usage

Use `MenuGroup` for an always-visible list of actions or destinations — the
content of a sidebar section, a settings list, a dropdown's body once it's
open. For the popup mechanics that open and close a menu, see `Popup`;
`MenuGroup` is the list inside it, not the popup itself.

## Best practices

### Pick the item kind for what the row does. {#pick-the-item-kind-for-what-the-row-does}

`ButtonItem` performs an action in place, `LinkItem` navigates to an `href`,
and `CustomItem` wraps a caller's own component for anything else — a label
around a checkbox, a row that isn't a button or a link at all.

```jsx
<MenuGroup>
    <Section title="Account">
        <LinkItem href="/settings">Settings</LinkItem>
        <ButtonItem onClick={signOut}>Sign out</ButtonItem>
    </Section>
</MenuGroup>
```

### `CustomItem`'s wrapper only shows up when `component` isn't a `div`. {#customitem-s-wrapper-only-shows-up-when-component-isn-t-a-div}

With the default `div`, the row itself carries `role="menuitem"`. With a
different `component`, that role moves to an unstyled wrapper so the inner
element keeps its own native semantics (a `label`, for instance) while the
menu still sees an allowed child.

### Group rows by what they have in common. {#group-rows-by-what-they-have-in-common}

Two to five sections of a few rows each scan faster than one long list. Title a section when its purpose is not obvious from its rows, and separate it when it changes kind, such as moving from navigation to actions.

Do: Rows grouped by purpose, with titles and a separator where the kind changes.
Don't: One long run of mixed rows, with nothing to scan by.

### Keep the description to one line. {#keep-the-description-to-one-line}

A description clarifies a row; it does not carry the row. If it needs two lines, the label is the problem.

Do: A short line that clarifies the label.
Don't: A long description does the label's job.

### Start action labels with a verb. {#start-action-labels-with-a-verb}

Do: A verb and the thing acted on.
Don't: Filler words in front of every label.

## Accessibility

- **A real `menu` with arrow keys.** `MenuGroup` is `role="menu"`; Arrow Down
  and Arrow Up move focus between enabled items and wrap at the ends. Buttons
  and links are tab stops; a `CustomItem` rendered as a `div` is reached by the
  arrow keys only when the caller gives it a tab stop. The group does not yet
  collapse the items into one tab stop.
- **Sections are named groups.** A `Section` with a `title` is
  `role="group"` with `aria-labelledby` pointing at that title.
- **Disabled items leave the tab order.** `isDisabled` removes a `LinkItem`'s
  `href` and tab stop, and sets `aria-disabled` on every item kind.
- **`isSelected` is `aria-current`**, read by assistive technology as the
  active choice, independent of visual selection styling.

## Related

- For the popup that opens and closes around a menu, use `Popup`.
- For a horizontal row of destinations instead of a vertical list, use `Tabs`.

Same group: `Breadcrumb` · `Link` · `Pagination` · `Sidebar` · `Tabs`

## Parts

1. **Group.** The scrollable `menu` the sections sit in; `density` sets the row height.
2. **Section.** A titled run of rows; `hasSeparator` draws a divider above it.
3. **Row.** A `ButtonItem`, `LinkItem` or `CustomItem` with an optional leading icon, a label, a description and a trailing icon.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Body ink on a clear ground. |
| Hovered | The subtle neutral hovered fill. |
| Pressed | The subtle neutral pressed fill. |
| Focused | The 2px ring, 2px off the row. |
| Selected | The selected fill, with `aria-current` on the row. |
| Disabled | Disabled ink; a disabled link drops its `href` and its tab stop. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Start each label with a verb for an action: “Rename board”. | Start every label with “Go to” or “Click to”. |
| Use sentence case, without ending punctuation. | Use Title Case or a trailing period. |
| Write section titles as short nouns: “Recent”, “Actions”. | Write a sentence in a section title. |
| Pair a leading icon with a label that still reads without it. | Rely on the icon alone to say what the row does. |
